Relive It All Over Again

2016 was something else. And we’ve got four Decades #TBTB faves as your ultimate throwback.

Explore MenuLearn More

At participating U.S. Taco Bell® locations, while supplies last. Contact local restaurant for price, participation, and hours of operation, which vary. Price excludes tax.

Satisfy Your Cravings

Love At First Fry

Chicken Enchilada Nacho Fries – prepare your cravings to be swept off their feet.

Order Now

At participating U.S. Taco Bell® locations for a limited time only, while supplies last. Check store for price & participation, which vary. Other exclusions apply. Tax extra.

Bold New Burritos

Get $3 Steak Burritos on the Luxe Value Menu—choose Fresca or Melty Pepper Jack.

Order Now

At participating locations for a limited time only (if applicable), while supplies last. Contact restaurant for prices, hours and participation, which vary. Taxes extra. Prices higher with delivery. In combos and boxes, drinks exclude freezes and specialty beverages.

Quesadilla’s on a Roll

Rolled and packed with 2x the slow-roasted chicken. Meet the Cantina Chicken Rolled Quesadilla. You’re welcome.

Order Now

At participating U.S. Taco Bell® locations while supplies last. Contact store for participation, which varies. Drinks exclude Freezes and specialty drinks. Other exclusions apply. *Double the Slow-Roasted Chicken as compared to Cantina Chicken Soft Taco.

What's Happening On the App

Collect All the Nostalgia

Celebrate Decades #TBTB by playing our Decades #Discovery to unlock weekly offers.1

$0 Delivery Fee*

Get a $0 delivery fee* when you spend $25+ thru 9/16.*

New Drops Arrive Every Tuesday

Exclusive offers, experiences, and opportunities for Rewards Members.◊

Choose Your Free Reward

Your free reward awaits on our app. All it takes is you joining Taco Bell Rewards.°

1$1 Large Nacho Fry with Purchase of Any Decades Menu Item Offer valid for 7 days from issuance until 11:59 p.m. PT. Redeem one (1) Large Nacho Fries for $1 (plus applicable taxes) with the purchase of one (1) qualifying Decades menu item: Meximelt®, Beefy Crunch Burrito, Caramel Apple Empanada, Naked Chicken Chalupa or Discovery Luxe Box™. Redeemable only via the Taco Bell mobile app or check-in at the kiosk or drive-thru at participating U.S. Taco Bell® locations, while supplies last. Not available for delivery orders placed outside the Taco Bell app. Must be a registered Taco Bell Rewards member to redeem. Valid one (1) time only. No product or ingredient substitutions, upgrades or add-ons. Offer is non-transferable and cannot be combined with any other offer. No cash value. Terms and conditions.

*Excluding Colorado, where $0.31 state-mandated retail delivery fee also applies. On 8/3/26 at 12:01 AM to 9/16/26 at 11:59 PM, when you place a delivery order of $25 or more (before taxes, tips, and fees) on the Taco Bell app, you can enjoy $0 delivery fee at participating U.S. Taco Bell® locations, while supplies last. Delivery is not available in all locations. Items available for delivery, prices & participation vary. Taxes and tip apply. Must be a registered Taco Bell Rewards Member in order to redeem. Not valid in-store or with a pickup order. Valid one (1) time per registered user, per day. Reward is non-transferable and cannot be combined with any other offer. No cash value. Product packaging may vary. Terms and conditions.

◊Rewards and offers subject to change at any time. Taco Bell® Rewards Program is available at participating U.S. locations and subject to Terms and conditions.

°Free-sign-up reward valid for 14 days from issuance and redeemable only via the Taco Bell mobile app for in-store/drive-thru pickup orders, at participating U.S. Taco Bell® locations, while supplies last. Not available for a web pay-ahead, pickup order or delivery order. Must be a registered Taco Bell app user in order to redeem. Reward valid once per registered user. No product or ingredient substitutions, upgrades or add-ons. Reward is non-transferable and cannot be combined with any other offer. No cash value. Terms and conditions apply.

News to Know

Your new fave café is inside a Taco Bell. Treat yourself to one of 20+ deliciously surprising beverages.​
